text:
Alex K: heads-up — vendor said they can move 40 H100s from EU pool into NA, ETA 2024-04-12 to 2024-04-15 but with a stagger and a 3% expedite fee. Thoughts on where to stage and how to handle RMA backlog? cc @Maria S

Maria S: fyi i asked Aurora Logistics for line-item lead times. Their current is 18-22 days standard, or 7-9 days with expedite (+3% on unit cost + $1,500 air handling). They only allow split AWB for up to 20 units; anything else becomes separate AWBs.

Jordan L: cluster constraints: us-west-2 has one 12-slot staging rack with power/PDUs prewired but thermal headroom is low. If we route 24 units there we'll hit cooling cap during daily peak. Prefer bulk -> us-east-1 and reserve us-west for ~8 urgent nodes.

SREbot: ALERT: cluster-pressure/us-west-2 GPU thermal headroom = 18% (threshold 20%). Suggested acceptance cap = 8 new units until cooling upgrade.

Sasha P: logistics note — forwarder needs HS code (8471.80) + full serial manifest >=48h before departure. If we pre-stage RMA labels in vendor portal we can fast-track warranty replacements. Also need proof-of-origin doc for customs waiver.

Alex K: ok — @Maria S can you negotiate AWB split like: 8 expedited -> us-west, 32 -> us-east (split into two AWBs to avoid single massive manifest)? Need exact expedite fee breakdown.

Maria S: vendor replied: can do 8 expedited as single AWB for $1,500 handling + $3,200 expedite surcharge. Remaining 32 split into two AWBs to reduce customs delay. I'll push PO amendment and upload to portal.

Vince W: finance check — pls send me the delta asap. Need unit-level pricing: base, expedite surcharge, air handling, insurance. Also confirm transit liability (vendor vs us) and incoterms.

Jordan L: ops ask — we need pre-provisioning tags and temporary node IDs to map to serials for RMA reconciliation. Suggested quick script to generate temp IDs for the manifest: ```bash
python tools/gen_temp_node_ids.py --count 40 --prefix na-temp-
# outputs CSV: temp_id,expected_serial
```

Sasha P: logistics warning — US customs will sometimes hold split AWBs if manifest ranges overlap or serials mismatch. Vendor must send exact serial ranges per AWB and include invoice with HS code + PO ref.

Maria S: Aurora confirmed they will upload serial manifest 72h prior and link tracking. They asked for our shipping contact and KYC contact. Who is owning handoff?

Alex K: Sasha you own handoff. Jordan coordinate the pre-provisioning script with SRE. Vince I will DM you the cost sheet. I'll also ask vendor to create an RMA bucket in their portal and attach pre-generated labels for the expedited 8. :thumbsup:

SREbot: INFO: deploybot created channel #rma-recv-1788888888 and scheduled pre-stage job at 2024-04-10 02:00 UTC.

Jordan L: noted. i'll run a dry-run to ingest a sample manifest tomorrow. If we see >5% serial mismatch on the dry-run we will halt acceptance and escalate to procurement.

Alex K: perfect — follow-ups: Maria get amended PO + liability note, Sasha confirm shipping contact & forwarder SLA, Jordan run dry-run and post results in #rma-recv-1788888888. We should be able to accept the expedite batch without impacting production if all checks pass.
